title: With You: Mitsumeteitai
overview:
The "bond" that ties three childhood friends together is now about to change through each one's own "love"......

With You: Mitsumete Itai is a romance adventure about Masaki and his two childhood friends, Manami and Naori. Manami moved away before Masaki could tell her how he felt. Six years later she suddenly returns, and the friendship between the three becomes complicated.

You follow the story and make choices that lead toward one of two storylines, one centered on Manami and one on Naori. A symbol in the corner of the screen shows which of the two you are currently closer to.

- Romance adventure for one player
- Two story paths
- Two CD-ROMs, memory backup saves

幼なじみ3人をつなぐ『絆』が今、それぞれの『愛』によって変わろうとしている……
